metaDescription: Show speed, heading, altitude and coordinates from the device GPS in km/h, mph, knots or m/s, with trip distance and max speed. Nothing is sent by this page.
intro: Use a phone or laptop as a simple speedometer and position display.
why:
The page asks the browser for location with high accuracy and shows the speed reported by the positioning system, heading, altitude, accuracy, maximum speed and a trip distance computed with the haversine formula from fixes with good accuracy. Units can be switched at any time.

Speed comes from the GPS chip where available; devices that estimate location from Wi-Fi may report no speed. Your browser, not this page, talks to location services. Do not operate a phone while driving.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.

faq.a: This page does not transmit it; the browser may use a location service to find it.
Without a GPS fix the browser may only estimate position.
Typically within a few km/h outdoors with a clear sky.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
